class.name: WorldMesaDecorator
class.brief_description: Creates flatter rock tops with steeper margins.
class.description: Uses a narrow smooth threshold on broad noise to form flat-topped mesas. This remains a surface profile; it does not generate overhangs. ADD_SOLID produces grounded outcrops. Shared elevation, seed, composition, material and interior controls are inherited from [WorldTerrainDecorator].
